title: Solar Storm!
description: A burst of energetic particles from the Sun is heading for the spacecraft.

options.label: Enter safe mode
options.explanation: Safe mode protected the electronics; only 3 days of science were lost.

options.label: Keep observing
options.description: Risk damage to keep collecting data.
options.explanation: The storm passed without harming the instruments — this time.
options.badExplanation: Energetic particles damaged an instrument; science output dropped by 30% for the rest of the mission.

title: Micrometeoroid Strike
description: A tiny grain of dust hit a solar panel and cut its output by 10%.

options.label: Reduce load
options.explanation: Running a bit lighter kept the power system safely balanced.

options.label: Full operations
options.explanation: There was enough power margin to keep everything running.
options.badExplanation: Without enough power margin the spacecraft browned out and lost 10 days of science.

title: Ground Station Outage
description: Your ground station is down for maintenance.

options.label: Rent a backup station
options.explanation: The backup station kept the data flowing.

options.label: Wait it out
options.explanation: Data piled up on board for 3 days until the station came back.

options.label: Switch to spare wheel
options.explanation: The spare wheel took over and pointing stayed perfect.

options.label: Magnetorquer mode
options.explanation: Magnetorquers helped hold attitude, but pointing is 5 times worse.

options.label: Accept the loss
options.explanation: With one wheel gone, pointing became 20 times worse.

title: Budget Cut!
description: The agency cut 10% of the mission budget.

options.label: Pay from reserve
options.description: Use your reserve to cover the cut.
options.explanation: Your reserve absorbed the cut and the mission continued unchanged.

options.label: Shorten the mission
options.explanation: The mission was shortened by one year.

options.label: Cheaper ground network
options.explanation: A cheaper ground network saved money but reduced downlink.

title: Computer Reset
description: A cosmic ray flipped a bit and the flight computer rebooted.
autoHandledText: The rad-hard computer detected the bit flip and fixed it on its own. No science was lost.

options.label: Reload software
options.explanation: The reload took a day; the bug may come back.

options.label: Upload a patch
options.explanation: The patch fixed the root cause, so this cannot happen again.

title: Space Debris Close Approach
description: A piece of debris will pass very close.

options.label: Dodge
options.explanation: A small burn moved the spacecraft safely out of the way.

options.label: Stay on course
options.explanation: The debris missed.
options.badExplanation: The debris hit the spacecraft and ended the mission.

options.label: Follow up
options.explanation: Following up turned a surprise into a headline result.

options.label: Stick to the plan
options.explanation: The team stayed on schedule; the discovery went unexplored.

title: Global Dust Storm on Mars
description: A planet-wide dust storm covers Mars.

options.label: Observe the storm
options.explanation: Studying the storm produced rare atmospheric science.

options.label: Focus on relay
options.explanation: Rovers kept their link home.

title: Battery Wearing Out
description: The battery now holds only 80% of its charge.

options.label: Save power in eclipse
options.explanation: Lighter eclipse operations protected the battery.

options.label: Push on
options.explanation: The battery coped with full operations.
options.badExplanation: The tired battery ran flat in eclipse and the spacecraft lost 15 days of science.
